target: Unchanged recorded low-Elo actor legal move; no relabeling to engine choice
filtering: Prefer large log(best legal v2 prior / actual-move v2 prior); retain 25% unfiltered low-Elo states for basic play
filterOnly: Frozen v2 is used once before training. The new network starts randomly and inference uses only its own logits.
limits: Disagreement with a learned prior is a mistake proxy, not a proven search blunder. Heldouts unchanged from low-Elo1350 data; excludes their canonical states before selection. Strength/coherence measured separately.
reason: ot_default_infer exposes uniform Pattern priors in this ABI; zero gaps were detected before training. Replaced with explicit ot_pattern_predict logits, separate v2 dataset.
